tooltip.auto_crafting_table.auto_craftin: Crafts one recipe over and over from your storage network. Place it on an Inventory Connector or cable.
gui.auto_crafting_table.tip.ingredient_c: %s (%s in storage). Right-click for another type.
gui.auto_crafting_table.tip.dust: Redstone: %s crafts of charge left, %s dust in storage. Uses 1 dust per %s crafts.
gui.auto_crafting_table.setting.redstone: On: a redstone signal pauses the terminal.
gui.auto_crafting_table.setting.fuel.tip: On: uses one dust from storage per 64 crafts.
gui.auto_crafting_table.setting.mixed.ti: On: any planks work, like a normal crafting table.
gui.auto_crafting_table.setting.server_n: On a server, the server's config file is used.
gui.auto_crafting_table.filter.tip: Click to switch between all recipes and only the ones storage has ingredients for.
gui.auto_crafting_table.power.tip: Turns the terminal on or off. While it's on, a redstone signal can still pause it.
